evidence.note: assertReviewRunStartCliSurface verifies review_run_start persists signed review-runs.json fields including reviewRunId, lane, reviewRound, promptHash, headHash, materialHash, and startedAt.

entries.desc: review_run_start rejects non-reviewer lanes, missing story/worktree context, and attempts outside an active currentReviewRound.

evidence.note: assertReviewRunStartCliSurface rejects unsupported reviewer lane and REVIEW stories without currentReviewRound, and stale run reuse after material changes.

entries.desc: A tampered review run signature or mismatched lane cannot be treated as valid reviewer run evidence.

evidence.note: assertReviewRunBindingRejectsInvalidEvidence verifies tampered review-runs signatures and wrong-lane run bindings are rejected by the REVIEW gate.

entries.desc: review_pass_set and finding_add accept reviewRunId, persist it in signed artifacts, and REVIEW status counts valid current run-bound pass/finding evidence.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
evidence.note: Valid current reviewRunId-bound findings and review passes are persisted, signed, counted by reviewer status, and allow REVIEW gate success.

entries.desc: Legacy evidence remains readable for old stories without currentReviewRound, but current REVIEW rounds require run-bound evidence for required lanes.

evidence.note: assertLegacyReviewEvidenceWithoutCurrentRoundStaysReadable proves old stories without currentReviewRound keep legacy signed review pass readability while new rounds require run-bound evidence.

entries.desc: REVIEW→TEST rejects missing reviewRunId, stale run hash, wrong lane, wrong round, or evidence created before the active REVIEW round.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
evidence.note: Tests assert REVIEW gate failures for missing reviewRunId, wrong lane, tampered signature, and stale material hash before accepting reviewer evidence.

entries.desc: Reviewer dispatch and reviewer prompts tell reviewers to run review_run_start first and pass reviewRunId into review_pass_set/finding_add.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-pass-discard-smoke && node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex

entries.desc: process-fact-registry and verify-process-fact-contract register review_run_start and review-runs.json as signed gate evidence.

evidence.note: Process fact contract verifies review_run_start, signed review-runs.json, review-run-boundary policy, registry levels, CLI schema, and gate semantics are registered.

entries.desc: Prompt examples for pass-only findings still use review_pass_set rather than finding_add and include reviewRunId.

evidence.note: Prompt drift scan fails pass-only finding examples and reviewer evidence examples lacking reviewRunId; all active reviewer prompt/template copies passed.

entries.desc: Contract verification fails synthetic prompt/registry drift where review_run_start or reviewRunId is omitted from reviewer evidence flow.

evidence.note: Synthetic contract checks now require review_run_start and reviewRunId for reviewer evidence flow, preventing prompt-only drift from satisfying the contract.

entries.desc: Focused smokes pass for valid run-bound reviewer passes/findings and show current-review evidence can advance REVIEW→TEST.

evidence.note: Focused smoke suite passes for valid run-bound reviewer evidence, prompt/dispatch guidance, and review pass/finding persistence.

entries.desc: Regression coverage keeps old-story compatibility without currentReviewRound while enforcing reviewRunId for new REVIEW rounds.
